name: GLM-5.3 Flash
description: Text-only GLM-5.3-Flash Frontier candidate with native KDA, NoPE MLA/KPool, mHC, and FP8 NVMe-MoE serving.
limitations: The text architecture is implemented but complete-checkpoint conversion, output parity, performance, and endurance gates are still in progress.
KPool sparse selection is currently eager and CUDA graph capture is disabled.
Multimodal certification is a separate later gate.
